progressRule: Only accepted real-task outcomes O1-O5 in a currently valid authority graph with G1-G4 passing count as progress. Documents, tests, inventories, fixtures, memberships, and research volume are supporting evidence only.

criteria.name: one goal-level natural-task autonomous closed loop
criteria.statement: On one pre-registered natural real task entered as goal-level demand without a user-specified capability route, the Agent observes available capability, assesses gaps, discovers only if needed, selects and dispatches the smallest sufficient task-scoped route, executes, recovers, verifies, releases exposure, and cleans up while the user supplies domain facts, bounded authority, corrections, and accountable final judgment.
criteria.metric: accepted demand-to-capability lifecycle receipt under the provisional evaluation protocol
criteria.threshold: one non-diagnostic real task begins without a user-specified capability, product, discovery channel, or invocation syntax; has zero material user capability-route-selection, setup, invocation, recovery, verification-command, cleanup, or push interventions; has zero material collaboration-loss events from intent or mode correction, material omission, reopened settled decisions, unrequested deliverables or mutations, unnecessary human round trips or process, resource or residue recovery returned to the user, context or handoff recovery returned to the user, or false completion and claim correction; records source-bound available-capability observation, gap assessment, optional discovery, route selection, task-scoped dispatch, execution, recovery, verification, route release, and cleanup; binds the selected route and every decision-relevant substrate to an exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; has zero repeated already-bound fact or authority requests; and passes named-human acceptance plus task-specific quality, safety, evidence, and residue floors

operationalization.passRule: The task enters at the goal level with no user-specified capability route; the source-bound lifecycle records every required stage in order; the selected route and every decision-relevant substrate bind exact source, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; the receipt is accepted by the named human; every declared task floor passes; material user capability-orchestration interventions, material collaboration-loss events, and repeated already-bound requests are all zero; and no undeclared task residue remains.
falsifiers: the task exists primarily to exercise or diagnose the Harness
the user must name or select a capability, product, discovery channel, invocation syntax, setup, recovery, verification command, cleanup command, or push route

the user must correct a material intent or mode error, omission, reopened settled decision, unrequested deliverable or mutation, unnecessary human round trip or process, resource or residue failure, context or handoff failure, or false completion or claim
capability discovery or task-scoped exposure is treated as required when observation shows no gap
the selected route or a decision-relevant substrate lacks exact source, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, or reuse boundary
any declared task floor fails or the named human does not accept the outcome and claim boundary
operationalization.humanAuthority: The named accountable human owns the task outcome decision and claim boundary, not the capability route.

criteria.name: repeated goal-level capability-orchestration burden transfer
criteria.statement: Across repeated natural real tasks entered at the goal level, the user supplies goals, domain facts, bounded authority, corrections, and final judgment while the Agent observes capability, detects gaps, discovers only when needed, selects and dispatches routes, executes, recovers, verifies, releases exposure, and cleans up.
criteria.metric: material user capability-orchestration interventions and collaboration-loss events per accepted outcome compared with a source-bound ad-hoc baseline
criteria.threshold: before execution, each task declares its goal-level demand entry, scenario class, complexity band, authority-risk band, capability-intervention and collaboration-loss event taxonomies, matched or historical baseline rule, task-quality floor, evidence floor, cleanup floor, selected-route substrate metadata rule, and named human acceptor; each selected route and decision-relevant substrate binds exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; at least three accepted tasks from three materially different scenario classes each have zero material user capability-orchestration interventions, zero material collaboration-loss events, zero user-specified capability routes required by the Agent, and zero repeated already-bound fact or authority requests; total material interventions per accepted outcome are strictly lower than the source-bound ad-hoc baseline and no task regresses below a declared floor

operationalization.sampleUnit: one accepted pre-registered natural-task receipt with a source-bound baseline
operationalization.passRule: At least three accepted receipts represent three pre-registered materially different scenario classes entered without an Agent-required user capability route; every receipt binds its selected route and decision-relevant substrates to exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; each has zero material user capability-orchestration interventions, zero material collaboration-loss events, and zero repeated already-bound requests; aggregate interventions per accepted outcome are strictly below the source-bound baseline without regressing any declared floor.
falsifiers: scenario class or baseline matching is selected after observing the result
fewer than three materially different scenario classes are accepted
the baseline is not source-bound or comparable under the pre-registered rule
a selected route or decision-relevant substrate lacks exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, or reuse boundary
the Agent transfers capability discovery, selection, invocation, or cleanup back to the user
a receipt omits or normalizes a material collaboration-loss event
any task regresses a declared floor
operationalization.humanAuthority: A named accountable human accepts each task outcome and the aggregate comparison claim boundary.

criteria.name: demand-driven capability discovery and lifecycle arbitration
criteria.statement: A broad and changing capability ecosystem can remain outside the user's cognitive path and the portable core's standing context while the Agent observes available routes, detects a task-bound gap, discovers through source-bounded adaptive channels only when needed, and dispatches and releases the smallest sufficient route by real marginal value rather than capability count.
criteria.metric: real-task capability observations, gap decisions, discovery receipts, route and exposure deltas, task-scoped lifecycle receipts, and retain-replace-retire outcomes
criteria.threshold: at least three natural-task route decisions across at least two route classes start with source-bound available-capability observation and residual-gap assessment without requiring portfolio-wide inventory or user route selection; at least one no-gap case retains the current route with no discovery or addition; at least one reproducible-gap case performs finite source-bounded discovery through a channel not enumerated as portable-core authority and compares only decision-relevant candidates; every external capability or product-layer substrate considered is bound to an exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; each decision reuses or adapts a sufficient native, official, or maintained external implementation and permits composition or authoring only for an evidenced residual semantic gap; every selected route is task-scoped and released when the need ends unless separate net-value evidence and authority justify continued activation; every admitted candidate and existing provisional self-authored or Hook projection receives inactive-retention, persistent-activation, merge, replacement, retirement, off, or expiry disposition

operationalization.sampleUnit: one evidence-backed route decision tied to an accepted natural-task context
operationalization.passRule: At least three route decisions across at least two route classes start from source-bound observation; include both a no-gap retain/no-discovery result and a reproducible-gap bounded-discovery result; keep discovery channels outside portable-core authority; bind every considered external capability or product-layer substrate to an exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; compare only decision-relevant candidates; reuse or adapt a sufficient existing layer before composition and author only for an evidenced residual semantic gap; end task-scoped exposure by default; and give every admitted candidate and provisional projection a bounded disposition without requiring user route selection or portfolio-wide inventory.
falsifiers: capability count, installation, or exposure is treated as marginal value
the user must know or select a capability, product, discovery channel, or invocation syntax because the Agent cannot route the task
the portable core requires a fixed capability catalog or discovery provider
a capability is added without a reproducible residual gap

the Harness authors a collaboration protocol, human-allocation schema, registry, gateway, search surface, runtime, identity or authorization layer, audit or provenance format, governance kernel, or evaluation mechanism already sufficient for the bound need without evidence of a residual semantic gap
an external candidate or substrate influences the decision without an exact source identity, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary
a task-scoped candidate remains exposed after the bound need ends without separate net-value evidence and activation authority
portfolio-wide inventory is required for a task-bound decision
operationalization.humanAuthority: The user retains portfolio ownership and any new trust, account, data, cost, or activation decision.

criteria.name: demand-to-capability collaboration methodology and quality profile
criteria.statement: The product owns only a demand-to-capability collaboration methodology, evaluation specification, and open minimum quality-conformance profile grounded in repeated real behavior. O4 calibrates that profile on the Codex reference host and software-engineering profile while reusing sufficient external layers; it does not prove Agent-neutral portability, which remains O5's separate burden.
criteria.metric: one accepted versioned methodology and quality profile applied to mixed pass-and-fail real-task receipts, with separately fixed external-substrate reuse and outcome-comparator cohorts, mandatory floors, applicability limits, and accountable human review
criteria.threshold: the same pre-registered methodology, quality profile, scorecard, and missing-data rules evaluate at least three O2-eligible accepted natural-task receipts from three materially different scenario classes and at least one rejected or stopped receipt; external protocol, human-allocation, runtime, identity and authorization, audit and provenance, and evaluation layers are bound to exact source identities, versions or commits, licenses or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundaries; a separate source-bound comparator cohort identifies at least one alternative implementation or ad-hoc route capable of producing comparable task outcomes and fixes its source, version, license or applicable terms, maturity, eligibility and matching rules, comparison axes, baseline results, and decision rule before results are observed; accepted receipts pass mandatory floors for outcome quality, user orchestration burden, intent and communication fit, reliability and recovery, authority and safety, evidence and residue, resource and context cost, and interface simplicity; the rejected or stopped receipt remains honestly failed rather than being normalized into success; the pre-registered comparison demonstrates a bounded advantage in user capability-orchestration burden or cross-layer lifecycle coherence; the accepted claim is limited to the tested reference host, profile, scenario classes, sources, and date and cannot claim Agent-neutral or cross-host portability before O5; a named accountable human accepts or rejects the methodology, profile, comparison, applicability limits, and claim boundary

operationalization.sampleUnit: one outcome-and-process receipt evaluated by one versioned scorecard
operationalization.passRule: One versioned methodology and open minimum quality-conformance profile use the same pre-registered scorecard and missing-data rules on at least three O2-eligible accepted receipts from three materially different scenario classes and at least one rejected or stopped receipt; all external substrate is fixed by source, version or commit, license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundary; a separate pre-registered comparator cohort contains at least one outcome-capable alternative or ad-hoc route with fixed source, identity, eligibility, matching, baseline, axes, and decision rule; every accepted receipt passes every mandatory floor and the failed receipt stays failed; the matched comparison shows a bounded advantage in user orchestration burden or cross-layer lifecycle coherence; applicability is limited to the tested host, profile, scenarios, sources, and date; and a named accountable human accepts the methodology, profile, comparison, applicability limits, and claim boundary without making an Agent-neutral portability claim before O5.
falsifiers: process or artifact completion substitutes for the bound outcome
a failed mandatory floor is hidden by an aggregate score
fewer than three materially different O2-eligible accepted scenario classes or no rejected or stopped receipt is evaluated
the scorecard, methodology, quality-conformance profile, or reference profile is changed after observing a receipt
the external substrate reuse cohort is treated as an outcome comparator without a separately eligible outcome-producing alternative or ad-hoc route
the comparator cohort, matching rule, baseline, comparative axes, decision rule, floors, or distinct-value hypothesis is chosen after observing the result
a maintained external implementation satisfies the claimed distinct value without the Harness layer

the Harness redefines a sufficient collaboration protocol, human-allocation pattern, runtime, identity or authorization system, audit or provenance format, or evaluator without an evidenced residual semantic gap
world-class, best-in-class, universal, or permanent superiority is claimed without a source-bound time-limited comparison
Agent-neutral or cross-host portability is claimed before O5
one host, fixed capability catalog, or software-engineering profile is presented as the universal product core
operationalization.humanAuthority: A named accountable human accepts or rejects the methodology, open minimum quality-conformance profile, reference-host calibration, evaluation specification, receipt decisions, applicability limits, and claim boundary.

criteria.name: portable closed-loop delivery
criteria.statement: The same Agent-neutral goal-level demand, authority, capability observation, gap assessment, bounded discovery, route choice, task-scoped dispatch and release, evidence, recovery, verification, cleanup, and acceptance semantics deliver equivalent accepted outcomes through thin host adapters.
criteria.metric: cross-host real-task receipts and adapter deltas
criteria.threshold: the same pre-registered goal-level natural task runs on the Codex reference host and a distinct second Agent host or runtime without requiring a user-specified capability route; exact host, runtime, model where material, and adapter identities and versions, license or applicable terms, maturity, reuse boundaries, execution dates, applicable task and profile, equivalence tolerance, and maximum portability claim are fixed before execution; both use the common demand-to-capability quality-profile semantics, bounded authority, explicit unsupported states, and zero task residue while reusing each host's healthy native or external protocol and runtime layers; discovery sources and host operations may differ only behind thin adapters; a second adapter on the same host is conformance evidence only and cannot pass O5; Codex-specific configuration is never treated as cross-Agent authority; the accepted claim is limited to the tested task, profile, host-runtime-adapter identities, versions, and dates

operationalization.sampleUnit: one matched cross-host receipt pair for the same pre-registered natural task
operationalization.passRule: One matched pair runs the same pre-registered goal-level task through exact pre-registered Codex and distinct-host runtime, model where material, and adapter identities and versions with bound license or applicable terms, maturity, and reuse boundaries, without a user-specified capability route; both outcomes are accepted within the pre-declared equivalence tolerance; demand, authority, observation, gap assessment, discovery, route, dispatch, release, evidence, recovery, verification, cleanup, and acceptance semantics remain common; host and discovery-source differences are confined to adapter plumbing; no task residue remains; and the accepted portability claim stays within the pre-registered task, profile, host-runtime-adapter, version, and date boundary.
falsifiers: the two hosts execute unrelated or non-equivalent tasks
equivalence tolerance is selected after observing the outputs

host, runtime, model where material, adapter identity or version, license or applicable terms, maturity, reuse boundary, execution date, applicable task or profile, or claim boundary is absent or selected after observing the outputs
core semantics fork by host rather than remaining behind thin adapters
the second receipt is another adapter on the same host
one matched task is generalized beyond its pre-registered host, version, date, task, profile, or claim boundary
operationalization.humanAuthority: A named accountable human accepts both host outcomes, their equivalence, and the portability claim boundary.

criteria.name: human authority preserved
criteria.statement: The product never infers new trust, account, cost, publication, release, destructive, or irreversible authority.
criteria.threshold: the program authority boundary contains exactly its code-owned user and Agent fields and values; all active, completed, and stopped work operations are inside that boundary and none overlap the human-only set; stopping work cannot erase an attempted authority violation; cancelled work is defined as never active or executed, so its declared operations are not treated as attempted authority

criteria.name: zero-trust claims and evidence
criteria.statement: Current state, capability effectiveness, outcome, and acceptance claims require source-bound evidence and a code-owned validator; inventory, exposure, tests, fixtures, and self-declaration cannot promote themselves.
criteria.metric: evidence identity, validator, authority, result, and claim-limit validation
criteria.threshold: the acceptance criteria contract is structurally valid and each criterion contains exactly its code-owned fields, with evidence binding permitted only for verified outcomes; every verified criterion passes a current criterion-scoped code-owned validator; each admitted strict and unambiguous JSON evidence document declares schema as literal integer 1, has a unique current identity, non-empty source locator and identity, full-precision observation-to-human-decision chronology, a named accountable human accepted decision, an accepted result, and non-empty claim limits; every declared criterion binds the same evidence file and maps to the exact completed causal work item and containing increment that produced it

criteria.name: independent lean current authority
criteria.statement: Only the current machine contract and historical-event-neutral kernel hold product authority; history, memory, consumer configuration, routing projections, temporary payloads, and predecessor identities remain non-authoritative.
criteria.metric: code-owned current-authority file, locator, identity, and symlink scan
criteria.threshold: all bootstrap authority files are present, all current authority JSON is strict and unambiguous, the constitution, program, and acceptance documents contain exactly their code-owned top-level fields; product purpose, success definition, current program purpose, progress rule, schema, collaboration burden split, numeric controls, booleans, other code-owned nested policy values, and the fixed historical milestone identity and claim limit retain their literal types and values; the release criterion names, statements, metrics, thresholds, and operationalization semantics match their code-owned contract identity; the product and Harness authority surfaces are fully enumerable, the Harness code surface contains no undeclared file or link outside the code-owned authority glob, active locators stay inside the repository and outside excluded roots, no active authority symlink exists, and zero forbidden identity or authority-path matches occur

criteria.name: bounded process and resource loss
criteria.statement: Every causal increment pre-registers a bounded process-loss contract and exact cleanup paths before work; actual loss is measured by the real-task outcome receipts rather than inferred from the budget declaration.
criteria.metric: increment process-loss contract, outcome mapping, and live residue check
criteria.threshold: current increment, work-item, process-loss, and cleanup-boundary objects contain exactly their code-owned fields, so a capability route cannot inject an undeclared workflow, human round trip, or cleanup obligation; an active increment has exactly one active work item, the current graph cannot queue planned increments or planned work items, and an outcome-bearing increment cannot open unless every mapped outcome has a code-owned evidence validator scoped to that criterion; the same correction class is budgeted to stop before recurrence and adjacent current increments cannot repeat one correction class; cancelled work is bound but never active or executed and still counts as one outcome-neutral planning loss, while stopped work was active or attempted and counts as process loss; a work item resets its outcome-neutral count only when evidence bound to that exact increment and work item passes current code-owned O1-O5 validation, never from a label or another work item's evidence; a closed outcome-neutral increment leaves the current program graph and remains recoverable only from Git history, while only a completed increment required by validated outcome evidence may retain its causal binding and a cancelled or stopped increment cannot; every work acceptance mapping is a subset of its increment mapping; each current increment declares a finite material-intervention budget and exact cleanup paths; the repository-wide cleanup surface is fully enumerable, and declared paths and conventional temporary residue are absent at verification
